title: The Team Default Test
document_title: Agent Field Notes No. 003 — The Team Default Test

source.name: GitHub Changelog
source.title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team

verified_facts.claim: Team customizations are GA for organization teams
verified_facts.quote: Team customizations are generally available for organization teams.

verified_facts.claim: Maintainers and owners select approved plugins as team defaults
verified_facts.quote: Team maintainers and organization owners can select approved Agent Plugins as team defaults.

verified_facts.claim: Setup happens on the team's Customize Copilot tab on github.com
verified_facts.quote: open your organization team on github.com and select the Customize Copilot tab

verified_facts.claim: Marketplace plugins can be browsed and added to the team
verified_facts.quote: Browse plugins from the marketplaces built into Copilot, your enterprise’s marketplaces, and any marketplaces the team adds.

verified_facts.claim: Defaults apply to direct members in VS Code, the app and CLI; child teams don't inherit
verified_facts.quote: Selected plugins are enabled by default for the team’s direct members in VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, and Copilot CLI. Members of child teams don’t inherit them.

verified_facts.claim: Members can turn a team plugin off where policy permits
verified_facts.quote: Members can turn a team plugin off in their Copilot client where policy permits.

verified_facts.claim: Policies take precedence over team choices
verified_facts.quote: Enterprise and organization policies take precedence over team choices.
Team customizations are available for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise.
